source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, before you start on concepts we’ll send you some concepts we like but of course we’re also interested in your own ideas. So I wouldn’t start on concepts just yet till we’ve got back to you. Thanks, Niki

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes let's go with your approach - intial drafts first. Thank you

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Hi Niki, please take a look at the initial drafts and let me know your thoughts. I'd love to hear your feedback.

Feel free to let me know if you'd like any revisions, refinements, iterations, or changes. I'm happy to work with you until we achieve a result that perfectly matches your vision.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports delivering the initial logo drafts for client review and feedback.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hi Niki, I have incorporated the feedback. Please review the updated designs and let me know your thoughts.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports incorporating the client's first detailed revision feedback into updated designs.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I believe these two options are about the maximum amount of character we can add without affecting the logo's overall quality and readability. Going beyond this point would start to take away from its clean, refined look and make it less versatile across different applications.

I've focused on adding subtle personality to the letterforms while preserving the premium, authentic feel of the brand. I feel this gives the logo a unique touch without compromising its overall balance and professionalism.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports producing two revised options with added character in the letterforms while preserving readability.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, oops I thought I’d got back to you!

We’d like to go agreed with that final version (above) - rev4-02. Thank you!

I’m assuming the logo would be with and without the black box (as a black box won’t work for everything)?

And we would get all colour variants you have shown?

However, I think the main logo would be the (graduated) orange ‘global’ with a black ‘dough’ and graduated orange strapline as shown in the top row of the final version.

So we just need logo guidelines and all file types to use across online, social media, on the truck itself and other hard copy materials eg pull up banners, or printed menus, uniform etc .

As the files will be large file sizes how do you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, Niki

execution.observed_behavior: Client reviews the revised work and selects version rev4-02 as the final logo.

routing_warnings.description: The detailed requests concerning the flame O, typography size, strapline contrast, and letterform character modify the visual design rather than the revision-process obligation.
The selected option and request for additional typographic character change the logo's visual design.
The requested U, H, and D letterform changes are visual-design modifications; the request itself is not an implementation Event for the revision-process Requirement.
